note: the perfectoid geometer at Bonn — living mind, not present at the table, surveyed third person from the published record. the body of work is a career of finding the probe-set at which wildly different objects become gauge, then collapsing with a clean conscience: perfectoid spaces (2012) and the tilting equivalence — characteristic 0 and characteristic p indistinguishable at the étale probe-set; diamonds — quotient-by-pro-étale-license made into a definition; prismatic and condensed mathematics (with Clausen) — topology re-seated at the probe-set of profinite sets; and the Liquid Tensor Experiment (2020–22), in which he handed his own hardest theorem to a proof assistant and its community — the one mind on this roster whose record already contains submitting his own mathematics to this house's kind of gate. seated at a meeting with Shinichi Mochizuki: the 2018 Scholze–Stix report ('Why abc is still a conjecture') performs the license half of the handshake — identify the isomorphic copies and Corollary 3.12 trivializes — against Mochizuki's insistence that the copies' distinctness-while-indistinguishable is load-bearing. references, which are the record: the perfectoid-spaces paper and the étale-cohomology-of-diamonds notes; the LTE announcement and completion posts; the 2018 report and its 2018 discussion-session addendum; his published remarks on the dispute since. the survey adjudicates nothing: it types the shapes he insists on, and the gate judges terms, not sitters.
